title: Meter-first restarted workers: budget cap closes exactly (residual charged), success measured directly on 512 fresh independent fixtures (CP95 0.99) x measured worst-arm merge survival at gap 40 (0.675) = 0.668; guard interaction and abab-family trap admission counted on 1.02e7 real walk steps; f2mul bigint-verified 0/10000 with mutation control, cyclotomic_sqr disclosed unverified and its span excluded from the price; claim 126.08

claims.statement: For the supplied nonidentity Q in BLS12-381 G2 and uniform z in GT, compute g=e(P0,Q), recover z=g^x by a Frobenius-class rho walk in GT and return [x]P0 verified against e(P,Q)=z.  PROTOCOL (meter-first): one global work counter in C units (C=20000 instructions per dense Fp12 multiply) is checked before every step; the walker ABANDONS at the cap.  1024 workers, trail (w,j) starts at g^a z^b for (a,b)=SHAKE256(sigma_w||j), ends at its FIRST DP report, emits one 52 B record, restarts.  The budget purchases S=56628313*2^100 steps at a measured step price of 24998.405 instructions = 1.2499 C: 5/8*22433 (multiply: dense reference 20000 + key 1487 + booth 405 + table 150 + exponent add 60 + common 331) + 3/8*29263 (squaring: dense reference 27000 + exponent double 40 + key 1487 + booth 405 + common 331) + 4.1554 (guard interaction row).  The guard row is MEASURED: on 10240000 real walk steps at Rg=2^16, depth 5, 6230 multiply steps were converted into cyclotomic squarings (6.083984375e-4 per step, per-segment max 7.93e-3), times the measured (squaring - multiply) delta of 6830 instructions.  No instruction span of an unverified kernel prices GT arithmetic: f2mul is repaired (cross term to c1, t0-t1 to c0 for u^2=-1) and verified with 0 mismatches on 10000 random vectors against a plain-bigint reference with a mutation control that fails 10000/10000; cyclotomic_sqr is disclosed as NOT verified (10000/10000 mismatch) and its v22 span is excluded.  The ledger closes at sum(rows)=cap exactly with the residual charged, and the claimed work is the purchased budget, not an identity about records: the v22 assertion that the record count is fixed by S and that purchased work equals executed work is WITHDRAWN, because trail lengths are random and neither count fixes the other.  SUCCESS is measured directly by running the full protocol (workers, cost meter, abandonment) on 512 FRESH fixtures, one trial each with fresh target, fresh table and fresh coins, so each fixture is one independent Bernoulli: 512/512 solves, exact Clopper-Pearson lower end 0.99.  A two-scale shape check (same protocol at 2x fixture: R 128->256, trails 128->256, cap 96->192) gives 256/256 with CP95 0.98837, rate delta 0.0 and CP95 delta -0.00163, holding walk:record shape (0.1234 vs 0.1227).  Production success is the one-line product CP95(fresh census)=0.99 x measured worst-arm merge survival at gap 40 = 0.675, giving 0.668 >= 0.39; the survival curve is re-measured with a LIVE guard history (v22's harness never grew its history, so its guard never fired and its true-merge control read 1.0 spuriously; with a live guard that control reads 0.8775 at gap 40 and the decay is disclosed).  The abab-family trap is counted on real walks rather than argued: 0 admissions in 10240000 steps at lengths 4, 6 and 8 (95% upper bound 2.93e-7 per step), versus 1.666e-2 at length 4 for the v20 configuration (Rg=4096, depth 1) and 9.994e-3 at length 8 for the class-only guard (Rg=12); waste is charged as rate_upper_bound x S because a trap can only waste purchased steps, with no independence premise, no m! tail and no prefix-extension argument.  Claim 126.08 in the fixed C=20000 units covers W=1.7947e42 instructions and the cap is closed by an explicit residual row.
